title: CJP Protest in Delhi highlights: Dipke targets PM Modi, says ‘sack Pradhan or become most incompetent PM in history’
description: CJP Protest in Delhi highlights: At the protest at Jantar Mantar on Sunday, Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke continued demanding the removal of education minister Dharmendra Pradhan, saying PM Narendra Modi's failure to do so would reflect poorly on his leadership.
